items.title: BRICS Summit Pushes Delhi Hotel Rates Up 4x as Room Supply Tightens
items.summary: Major events can send hotel rates sharply higher. But Delhi’s BRICS spike also shows how quickly hotel supply can get squeezed when demand arrives all at once.

items.title: Qatar’s Arrivals Are Down 30% This Year — Its Recovery Now Rests on F1
items.summary: Arrivals are still down a third from last year. Qatar’s answer, as it was for the World Cup, is another mega event on the calendar.

items.title: Air India’s $1.1 Billion Lifeline Comes with Conditions: Reports
items.summary: Air India's owners haven't run out of money. They've run out of patience. The $1.1 billion lifeline shows they are still willing to back the airline, but now they want results.

items.title: Amadeus Brings Travel Tech Into Claude
items.summary: Weeks after closing its self-service developer portal, Amadeus revealed that building new ties to connect its travel systems to Claude, both for developers and the travel workforce.

items.title: Emirates Pushes Premium Economy Upmarket as Business Class Gets Sliced Up
items.summary: Airlines can no longer rely on passenger growth alone, so they're fighting harder for travelers who will pay more.

items.title: Why Luxury GMs Need a Razor Sharp Point of View
items.summary: As brands scale and standards spread, the property leader’s most important role is preserving the reason a hotel belongs where it is.

items.title: How Airports Are Growing Without Blowing Their Climate Goals
items.summary: Airports insist that passenger growth and net zero aren’t in conflict but nearly all of their progress is over emissions that they control. The bigger problem, emissions that lie in the supply chain, is starting to gain traction.
